sections.title: AI Services for Chicago Insurance Organizations
sections.description: Production-grade AI built specifically for Chicago's insurance sector with Illinois DOI and NAIC compliance.

items.title: Underwriting Risk Scoring
items.description: ML models improving the accuracy and speed of risk assessment for property/casualty, commercial lines, life insurance, and specialty lines underwriting. Property risk scoring: computer vision analysis of property inspection images for damage assessment, renovation quality scoring, and risk classification. Commercial lines underwriting: ML on firmographic, financial, industry, and historical claims data. Life insurance risk assessment: predictive models incorporating alternative data sources (electronic health records with appropriate consent, behavioral data) alongside traditional actuarial factors. Specialty lines: cyber risk scoring, D&O liability risk prediction, and professional liability assessment ML. Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | Illinois DOI fairness context.
items.label: Underwriting

items.title: Claims Processing Automation
items.description: Chicago's high-volume insurance operations process thousands of claims daily across personal and commercial lines. AI automation reducing the manual processing burden: document extraction (AI extracting structured data from claims submissions, medical records, repair estimates); severity prediction (ML predicting claim cost from early loss data — enabling better reserving accuracy and case management prioritization); straight-through processing (automated approval for clearly valid, low-complexity claims); claims document generation (NLP generating standard claim correspondence, denial letters, and settlement offers). Cost: $35,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
items.label: Claims Automation

items.title: Insurance Fraud Detection
items.description: First-party fraud, third-party fraud, and provider fraud detection for Chicago's P&C and life insurance carriers. Claims fraud detection: ML identifying suspicious claim patterns — staged accidents, inflated medical bills, organized fraud rings — from claims data and network analysis. Application fraud: identity fraud and misrepresentation detection at policy inception. Provider fraud (healthcare): unusual billing pattern detection for workers' comp and health insurance providers. Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Fraud Detection

items.title: Customer Analytics and Churn Prevention
items.description: Chicago's direct and agent-distributed insurance carriers. Customer lifetime value prediction, renewal propensity scoring, and at-risk customer identification for proactive retention — particularly relevant for personal lines insurers competing in Chicago's price-competitive auto and homeowner market. Cost: $40,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks.
items.label: Customer Analytics

items.title: InsurTech Product AI
items.description: Chicago's growing InsurTech community — startups building embedded insurance products, usage-based insurance, and insurance distribution platforms. ClickMasters builds the ML and AI capabilities (risk scoring models, fraud detection, pricing engines) at the core of InsurTech products. Cost: $40,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–26 weeks.
items.label: InsurTech
